Method of Attack: The package compromises any computer it is installed on, potentially giving full control to an outside entity. It embeds malicious code that can exfiltrate secrets and keys, requiring immediate rotation of all stored credentials. Removing the package does not guarantee removal of all malicious software.
Impacted Systems: Any computer with the package installed or running
Attack Vector: Installation of the malicious npm package @diotoborg/mollitia-tempore
